title: Adversarial Search and Game Playing
overview: Choose moves in competitive two-player games by searching game trees under the assumption of an optimal opponent.
objectives: Compute minimax values on a game tree
Use evaluation functions and depth limits

method.title: Minimax
method.body: MAX picks the child with the highest value and MIN picks the lowest, so values propagate up from terminal states.

method.title: Alpha-beta pruning
method.body: Skips branches that cannot affect the final decision, returning the same value as minimax with fewer nodes.

method.title: Evaluation functions
method.body: When the tree is too deep, search stops at a depth limit and estimates positions heuristically.

method.title: Beyond minimax
method.body: Monte Carlo tree search samples playouts and is used in very large games.
